rules.numeric_aggregation: arithmetic mean of available filtered records
rules.telemetry_duplicate_policy: retain all supplied filtered records; original logs verify values and date repair only
rules.fridge_repair: Only 0?4 Apr 201 in fridge part 3; require exact rowwise measurement and original GMT agreement
rules.network_byte_basis: original wire length; population standard deviation ddof=0
rules.network_endpoint_pair: directed outer source/destination IP pair; no ports, no assumed device mapping
rules.interarrival: sort every complete packet timestamp within each group/bin across files; positive differences only; seconds; ddof=0; undefined means/std are missing
rules.duplicate_packets: retain records; identical input files rejected; equal timestamps are not proof of duplicate packets
rules.missing_values: preimputation NaN and explicit observation masks; canonical zero fill, never forward/backward interpolation
rules.empty_network_bins: unobserved; do not infer zero measured traffic from an empty bin
rules.analysis_interval: longest intersection of general and IoT-named packet sessions and telemetry occupied-bin spans (gaps >60 s); ties choose earliest; exclude first/last bins not fully inside that coordinate interval; bin occupancy does not prove acquisition continuity
rules.incomplete_capture_policy: complete-record prefixes allowed as a new conditional dataset; incomplete record omitted; its entire bin masked; if header incomplete mask last complete-record bin
rules.malformed_capture_policy: stop before evaluation; keep earlier per-file caches and error report
rules.clock_policy: zero offset; no performance/overlap-optimised alignment; UTC coordinates do not prove physical clock synchronization
rules.historical_identity: new dataset; no historical byte-identical reconstruction claim
